private_milestone_desc: IBM PC launched Aug 1981; business desktops mainstream across US white-collar firms by late 1980s (uncontroversial common knowledge, not independently sourced this turn)
ns_milestone_desc: DoD/IC desktop rollouts through late 1980s-1990s (e.g. Army desktop contracts); no clean dated program-of-record milestone sourced this turn
notes: GAP: could not source a specific DoD/IC desktop program-of-record date this turn (search budget exhausted). Private-side IBM PC 1981 is common knowledge but not independently fetched. Lag estimated ~5-10 yrs by analogy; treat as illustrative only.

private_milestone_desc: Corporate email mainstream mid-1990s; commercial web late 1990s (not independently sourced this turn)
ns_milestone_desc: NIPRNet/SIPRNet stood up early-to-mid 1990s; routine DoD email/web use by late 1990s (dates not fetched this turn)
notes: GAP: NIPRNet/SIPRNet founding dates and corporate-email mainstream share not fetched this turn. Included for completeness; do not treat dates as sourced.

private_milestone_desc: Open source mainstream in enterprise IT by mid-2000s (Linux, Apache); private-side share not fetched this turn
ns_milestone_desc: DoD CIO memo 'Clarifying Guidance Regarding Open Source Software (OSS)' issued 16 Oct 2009, treating OSS as commercial software
source_title: Finally! SecDef signs Clarifying Guidance Regarding Open Source Software
notes: 2009 DoD OSS memo date corroborated by multiple contemporaneous tech-press items (Linux.com, OpenSourceConnections, Slashdot 27 Oct 2009). Private-side mainstream year is an estimate, not fetched.

private_milestone_desc: AWS launched S3/EC2 in 2006; enterprise cloud adoption reached majority of large firms ~2015-2016
ns_milestone_desc: CIA C2S commercial cloud contract to AWS, up to $600M over 4 yrs, won early 2013 (first IC commercial cloud); FedRAMP launched Dec 2011; JEDI cancelled Jul 2021; JWCC multi-cloud $9B awarded 7 Dec 2022 (AWS, Google, Microsoft, Oracle)
source_title: Amazon win restarts CIA cloud contract
notes: CIA/AWS C2S $600M confirmed (Washington Technology 2013-10-08). FedRAMP launched 8 Dec 2011 via OMB memo by Federal CIO Steven VanRoekel (Perkins Coie). JWCC $9B awarded 7 Dec 2022 to 4 vendors (DefenseScoop/SiliconAngle). JEDI (~$10B) cancelled Jul 2021. Private mainstream ~2015 is an estimate.

private_milestone_desc: Apple iPhone 2007; smartphones mainstream in enterprise by ~2011-2012 (BYOD era)
ns_milestone_desc: DISA approved Apple iOS 6 STIG for DoD networks 17 May 2013 (shortly after BlackBerry 10 and Samsung Knox STIGs); DoD had >600,000 commercial mobile devices (470k BlackBerry, 41k Apple, 8.7k Android) in use/pilot; NSA Commercial Solutions for Classified (CSfC) program enables commercial devices for classified
source_title: Apple garners DISA approval for its mobile operating system
notes: DISA iOS 6 STIG 17 May 2013 and 600k-device figures confirmed. iPhone 2007 common knowledge. NSA CSfC program overview at nsa.gov (date not fetched). Lag iPhone->DoD approval ~6 yrs.

private_milestone_desc: Zoom founded 2011/scaled ~2013; Microsoft Teams 2017; enterprise video-conf mainstream by ~2019
ns_milestone_desc: DoD Commercial Virtual Remote (CVR) environment, a DoD-licensed Microsoft Teams (Office 365, IL2), launched Mar 2020; ~1.3M users; built in ~1 month during COVID-19; request received 17 Mar, dept-wide clearance within a week
source_title: Pentagon shattered speed record to give 1 million people remote work tools
notes: COUNTER-EXAMPLE of compressed lag: pandemic forced ~1-month deployment vs usual years. CIO Dana Deasy: CVR 'obliterated the myth that it takes years to deploy at scale.' 1.3M users; +250k in one night.

private_milestone_desc: Agile Manifesto 2001; DevOps/DevSecOps mainstream in commercial software by early-2010s
ns_milestone_desc: Air Force 'Project Kessel Run' approved Apr 2017 (first AF software factory, agile/DevSecOps); 29 DoD software factories by Feb 2022 (Hicks memo encouraging wider use)
notes: Kessel Run formal approval Apr 2017, became AFLCMC Det 12 on 8 May 2019; 29 software factories by Feb 2022. Private-side mainstream year estimated. Grade C (Wikipedia secondary); underlying dates well attested.

private_milestone_desc: AlexNet 2012 sparked deep-learning boom; production ML mainstream in big-tech/enterprise ~2015-2017
ns_milestone_desc: Project Maven (Algorithmic Warfare Cross-Functional Team) established by DepSecDef memo 26 Apr 2017 (computer vision on drone video); JAIC established 27 Jun 2018; CDAO began operations 1 Jun 2022 (absorbed JAIC); Maven became program of record 7 Nov 2023
notes: Maven 26 Apr 2017 (Work memo), JAIC 27 Jun 2018, CDAO 1 Jun 2022 all corroborated across CRS/DefenseScoop/Wikipedia. Lag industry-production-ML (~2015) to DoD mainstream (CDAO 2022) ~5-7 yrs.

private_milestone_desc: ChatGPT released 30 Nov 2022; McKinsey: 33% of orgs regularly using GenAI in >=1 function (survey Apr 2023), rising to 65% (survey early 2024)
ns_milestone_desc: DoD Task Force Lima (CDAO) established 10 Aug 2023; Air Force NIPRGPT pilot launched Jun 2024 (>80k users by Sep 2024); CDAO frontier-AI contracts up to $200M each to Anthropic/Google/OpenAI/xAI Jul 2025; GenAI.mil launched 9 Dec 2025 (Gemini), reached ~1.7M of ~3M personnel by Sep 2026 (~500k daily power users), >100k custom agents
notes: GenAI.mil 1.7M users corroborated by Fortune 2026-09-01 (1.7M of 3M) and DefenseScoop 2026-06-12 (1.5M, up from ~80k Dec 2025). ChatGPT->DoD enterprise-scale ~3 yrs: unusually fast, top-down ('wartime footing', Hegseth). McKinsey 33%/65% grade B. $200M contracts via Fortune (exact Jul 2025 CDAO announcement date not re-fetched this turn).

private_milestone_desc: Commercial agentic AI (autonomous multi-step agents) emerged 2024-2025; agentic coding/security tools mainstream in industry 2025-2026
ns_milestone_desc: US CYBERCOM 'AI for Cyber Operations' first dedicated funding FY26 $5M -> FY27 $138M request (2,660% rise, May 2026); Army Cyber Task Force Lexington established Apr 2026 building agents for cyber work roles incl red-teaming (17 agentic/protection mission elements daily by Aug 2026); ARCYBER 'ECHOTRIBBLE' autonomous offensive-cyber agent procurement, vendor selected 8 Oct 2026. Routine/program-of-record majority use NOT yet reached (projected)
source_title: Army cyber chief reveals AI task force building agents to hunt in the DoD networks
notes: PROJECTION ROW. NS experimentation (2026) is near-concurrent with private-sector agentic emergence - lag has nearly vanished under explicit push. CYBERCOM FY27 $138M (Breaking Defense 2026-05-12). ECHOTRIBBLE described newspaper-level only (The Intercept 2026-10-19, WinBuzzer 2026-10-20). Routine majority-use projected low 2027 / high 2029-2030. See memo for reasoning.
